english.quote: IELTS – 6.5 overall, with a minimum of 5.5 on each section (IELTS score sheet should be sent directly from the test center to Bilkent University) TOEFL iBT – 87 in total
english.notes: Proficiency to skip the English Language Preparatory Program (or Bilkent's own PAE exam on arrival); below it the preparatory programme is compulsory. Results must be within two-year validity at registration.

value.description: No school-grade threshold; SAT >= 1000/1600 (Math + Critical Reading), or GCE A Level (3 at C or better), IB >= 28/45, or listed national qualifications.

gpa.quote: Reasoning Test: A minimum score of 1000 out of 1600
gpa.notes: Test-score threshold (SAT). The page states the minimums for the 2026-2027 intake; 'Meeting these minimum qualifications does not guarantee admission'.

deadline.quote: Undergraduate applications for the 2026-2027 academic year fall semester will be open between 2 February – 12 July 2026
deadline.notes: population: international (international undergraduate application round). Only the 2026 cycle is published (2026/27 intake); no time of day or timezone.

value.population: international students and students admitted from abroad, admitted in 2026

tuition.quote: For students admitted in 2026 is 18,400 USD
tuition.notes: 'Tuition fee for the 2026 – 2027 academic year (including 10% VAT)'; annual fee paid in two equal instalments. Not the 2027/28 figure.

value.name: Bilkent tuition waiver scholarship for international students

scholarship_exists.quote: Qualified applicants are offered partial or full tuition waiver scholarships.
scholarship_exists.notes: Five levels, 20% to 100% of tuition; accommodation scholarship possible for a limited number of full-waiver students. Evaluated on grades, exam scores and programme choice: competitive. Renewal needs annual GPA >= 2.00/4.00. Tuition only: not a full ride.

scholarship_international.quote: Applicants and students, who previously had or already have Turkish citizenship are not eligible for international student scholarships.
scholarship_international.notes: The awards are the international student scholarships; Turkish citizens are excluded.
